verdict.rationale: BVNK supports named virtual accounts per customer (USD/EUR/GBP) and unique repeated-use blockchain addresses/channels per customer for crypto/stablecoin receipt, plus per-payment unique addresses and quotes, enabling attribution without manual matching; webhooks notify on payment events for reconciliation. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of reconciliation accuracy at scale and clearer documentation on uniqueness guarantees/collision handling for dedicated addresses across high transaction volumes.
